messages:
derek: Hey team, about to push 2026.03.20 -> prod. Canary looks green but deploy-bot is rejecting the run: 'insufficient_perms'. Who can press?

maria (release): @derek I pinned the canary to v2026.03.20-rc3 per the rollout playbook. We need a numbered rollback plan if the first 10% flaps.

derek: noted. deploy command I used: ```/deploy prod --image=redwood/inference:v2026.03.20-rc3 --canary=10%```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Permission check failed: user lacks prod:release:press scope. See https://go/release-roles.

sam (oncall): I can press but my MFA device is acting up (keeps returning 'otp invalid'). Tried re-sync.

derek: Ugh. Is that the Yubi? Sam, can you use backup OTP or jump to a temporary JIT? We need to avoid blocking the release window.

lia (security): We can't bypass MFA for prod presses. Ops can create a short-lived delegated token if you follow the JIT flow. Lia will need to approve in the next 10m.

maria (release): If Lia approves, ops-runbook has the JIT command. Lia, please confirm and I'll hold the canary gate open.

lia (security): Confirming. I approve a 15m JIT for sam if he requests via the portal and enables a secondary OTP method. I also want the deploy to include the new feature-flag kill-switch: `flags.deeplink=false` in the manifest.

ops-runbook: ops-runbook: JIT steps: ```1) sam requests /jit-request --scope=prod:release:press --ttl=15m 2) lia approves via /sec-approve <req-id> 3) deploy-bot will mint a delegated token and post back to thread```

sam (oncall): Done the request: /jit-request ID 98765. Lia, approving now.

lia (security): Approved 98765. Logging audit id 20260320-XY2. No exceptions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Delegated token minted: DEL-TOK-*** (15m). Permission: prod:release:press. Audit: 20260320-XY2.

derek: Thanks. Re-running deploy now. Will add rollback steps to the release notes after press.

maria (release): Good call. Derek, when you press, include `--rollback=2026.03.19` so we can revert fast. Also note the change window 09:00-10:30 PT in the notes.

derek: Pressed. Bot output: "started canary 10% -> 5 instances". Monitoring dashboards on the release page.

sam (oncall): Watching logs. No errors so far. Latency + tail p95 looks OK.

lia (security): Audit log updated. Reminder: rotate the delegated token if it wasn't used. It auto-expires.

maria (release): I'll finalize the release notes: bullet points + rollback pointer + steward. Adding Derek as short-term owner.

derek: If anything spikes in 15m we roll back to 2026.03.19. Otherwise we'll continue ramp at 30m -> 50% -> 100%.

ops-runbook: ops-runbook: post-commit checklist: verify canary metrics at t+5m, t+15m, tag the image and update changelog.

maria (release): Thanks everyone. Closing the thread once we hit 50%.
